$schema_description: Contribution template for adding or updating company interview preparation guides in data/company_interview_prep.json
typical_rounds: Round 2: Technical Interview 1 (Data Structures, Algorithms & Core CS)
Round 3: Technical Interview 2 (System Design, Resume Projects & Live Debugging)
Round 4: HR & Cultural Fit Interview (Behavioral, Leadership & Alignment)
commonly_tested_topics: Data Structures & Algorithms (Trees, Graphs, Dynamic Programming)
Database Management Systems (DBMS, Indexing & SQL Queries)
preparation_tips: Articulate your problem-solving thoughts aloud before jumping into code.
State time and space complexity upfront for both brute-force and optimal approaches.
Be prepared to explain trade-offs and architectural decisions in your resume projects.
Use the STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) method for all behavioral questions.
Prepare thoughtful questions about the company's tech stack and engineering culture.
